cad.title: PCB Enclosure
cad.subtitle: SolidWorks Product Design
cad.description: Designed a PCB enclosure in SolidWorks, where I learned how to use the Vent feature to provide adequate ventilation for the internal components. Throughout the project, I also improved my understanding of the Extruded Cut feature for creating precise openings and internal geometry. The project took approximately 15 minutes to complete. Additionally, I learned how to select appropriate materials for the application, reducing the enclosure's weight from 750 g in the initial design to 450 g in the optimized version while maintaining its functionality.
cad.problem: Design a compact PCB enclosure that protects the electronics while providing adequate ventilation and minimizing weight.
cad.solution: Designed and optimized the enclosure in SolidWorks using the Vent and Extruded Cut features, then selected an appropriate material to reduce the weight from 750 g to 450 g while maintaining functionality.
